messages:
Morgan: Heads-up — starting canary deploy for gateway-service v2.4.0 in the change window (now). Watching p95 latency and 5xx rate. deploy-bot will post updates. Canary targets: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. Manual approval at 25%.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: gateway-service v2.4.0 -> cluster-prod. Canary 5% created. Links: https://deploys.redwood.com/1748004321 · rollback: https://infra.redwood/runbooks/gateway-backout-v2

Alicia: Quick ask — any DB migrations in this release?

Morgan: No DB migrations. Just auth path changes behind feature flag `gateway.new-auth`. If we backout we can flip the flag or pin image.

Sam: Canary metrics: 3m in — 5xx rate jumped from 0.2% to 1.8% (small samples). p95 +40ms. tagging @Morgan @Alicia

Morgan: Thanks. Decision rule per runbook: if 5xx >1% sustained for 10m or user-facing errors — initiate backout. Sam, please keep monitoring for next 7m.

Joe: Noted. Checking infra logs for pod OOMs / restarts.

ops-bot: Observability alert: gateway-service p95 latency > baseline (600ms) — threshold breached (service=gateway, env=prod). Alert page: https://alerts.redwood.com/alert/1892

Sam: Seeing increased 502s from auth upstream. Might be interaction with `gateway.new-auth`. Recommend toggling flag off as first quick mitigation.

Alicia: Agree — try flag toggle first. If toggling fixes, can continue rollout. If not, backout to v2.3.7.

Morgan: Proceeding to toggle flag (manual rollback-lite) now. Callout to runbook section: "quick mitigation via feature flag" https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/gateway-backout-v2#flag-toggle

Morgan: (command run) ```bash
# LaunchDarkly API
curl -X PATCH \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://ld.api.internal/flags/gateway.new-auth \
  -d '{"on":false}'
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag change detected: gateway.new-auth -> false. Canary metrics re-evaluating in 2m.

Sam: After flag off: 5xx dropped to 0.4% at 4m, p95 back to baseline. No user reports so far.

Morgan: Good. Hold rollout. We will not promote to 25% until we confirm stability for 15m. Logging this action and noting rollback plan if regression returns.

Alicia: Documenting quick mitigation in the release notes and incident binder. Also noting that full backout commands are in the runbook in case flag toggle fails.

Joe: Paranoid check: if we need a full backout, runbook snippet for image pinning (copy here):
```bash
# pin gateway back to previous image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/gateway gateway=registry.redwood/gateway:v2.3.7
# restart pods gracefully
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/gateway
# verify
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/gateway
```

Morgan: Also traffic re-weight commands (service mesh):
```bash
# envoy manager - shift traffic
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/traffic/shift \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRA_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"gateway","from":5,"to":0}'
```

Sam: Assigning incident owner if we backout: @Sam (primary), @Alicia (secondary) — will create incident ticket if we execute full backout.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 5% per manual hold. No further automatic promotion.

Morgan: Summary: flag toggle fixed immediate errors; hold rollout. Action items: 1) monitor for 15m (Sam), 2) keep runbook and rollback commands ready (Alicia), 3) prepare postmortem if we backout (Joe). If regression returns, follow runbook: toggle flag, then if needed pin image to v2.3.7 and shift traffic.

Sam: Monitoring 10/15m — metrics stable so far. Will update at +15m.

Alicia: I've updated the release notes draft to include mitigation and the runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/notes/gateway-2.4.0

Morgan: Thanks team. If we need to backout later, use runbook link (again): https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/gateway-backout-v2 — it has owner contact steps, customer comms templates, and the exact commands above.

Sam: +1 metrics steady at 14m. No rollback needed at this time. Closing the canary hold in 1m for optional promote.

Morgan: We'll keep the change window open until midnight. If anything else pops, re-open thread.

Joe: Logged a small follow-up to check auth interaction in staging.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: no full backout required. Deployment status: succeeded (partial hold was lifted). Links: https://deploys.redwood.com/1748004321/result

Morgan: Marking this thread resolved. Post-release: create a short blameless note about the flag coupling and add a test to our canary checklist to cover this auth path. :white_check_mark:
